name: NEW SWARNIMA (Gopalak Nigam)
benefit: - **100% loan** assistance provided to eligible women- Loan amount up to **₹2.00 lakh**- Interest rate fixed at **5% per annum**- Loan can be used to **start a business** of the beneficiary’s choice- Meant for **economically backward women** of specific castes- **Encourages entrepreneurship and self-reliance**
_eligibility_text: 1. Be a permanent **resident of Gujarat**1. Be a **woman**1. Belong to the **Rabari or Bharwad caste**1. Belong to a **socially and educationally backward class** as recognized by the Government of Gujarat1. Be between **21 to 45 years** of age1. Have a **total annual family** income not exceeding **₹3.00 lakh**1. Intend to start your **own business or self-employment** venture using the loan
